basic_details.job_title: IIT Madras Teaching Program Coordinator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras), Office of Industrial Consultancy and Sponsored Research (IC&SR) has announced 1 vacancy for the post of Teaching Program Coordinator under advertisement number ICSR/PR/Advt.209/2026. The position is on a contract basis with an initial tenure of one year, extendable based on performance, and offers a pay of Rs. 45,000 per month. Eligible candidates holding an M.E/M.Tech, MSc/MA in Environmental Sciences, Economics, Management, or MBA can apply. Candidates must submit their applications through the online mode on or before 29 October 2026. The

content_sections.heading: IIT Madras Teaching Program Coordinator Job Description
content_sections.text: Developing the curriculum for 4-week NPTEL MOOC “Sustainability for All” open to any college student in India, offering core knowledge on Sustainability and an essential toolkit for sustainable solutions. Mapping of appropriate thematic experts who will serve as course instructors for “Sustainability for All” and maintaining effective communication with them throughout the process. Providing day-to-day support to the IIT Madras CODE Team for efficient management of course activities including faculty coordination, technical editing, and review of video transcripts and assignments. Supporting development of a course assessment tool to collect feedback from learners and to subsequently refine the course for the next cohorts. Supporting execution of existing School of Sustainability course modules conceptually aligned with “Sustainability for All”. Supporting creation of reports, flyers, brochures, Social Media posts and any other relevant communication materials to help maintain School of Sustainability’s active and positive public presence.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The Institute reserves the right to decide the mode of screening and testing the applicant for shortlisting and selection. Candidates will be short-listed for Test/Interview on the basis of information provided in their online applications. Calling a candidate for test or interview conveys no assurance whatsoever of recommendation or selection.
